title: Retain normal ellipticity and rational flux inversion at every simplex boundary
statement: For Sigma_N and E={sum J_i=0}, B(c)J_i=sum_{j!=i}f_ij(c_j J_i-c_i J_j) is self-adjoint in the interior c^-1 metric and has spectrum in[fmin,fmax] on E. Continuity of the characteristic polynomial extends that inclusion to the CLOSED simplex. Eliminating c_N,J_N gives M_ik=delta_ik sum_{j!=i}f_ij c_j-c_i f_ik+c_i f_iN (f_ii=0), det M>=fmin^(N-1). Thus D=M^-1 is a smooth rational coefficient matrix through zero species with spectrum[1/fmax,1/fmin] and finite computable concentration-derivative bounds. This is normal ellipticity, not Euclidean symmetric positivity or global nonlinear continuation.
